name: [ARGUS] Linux pipe-to-shell (T1059.004)
description: Detects curl/wget output piped directly into a shell (pipe-to-shell downloader) on Linux endpoints via Elastic Defend process telemetry. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1059.004 (Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell).
author: ARGUS
false_positives: Legitimate installer scripts (e.g. rustup, nvm) running as the operator user
query: host.os.type:"linux" AND process.command_line:(*curl* OR *wget*) AND process.command_line:(*\| sh* OR *\| bash*)
